نشتجر (form VIII)
# نَشْتَجِرُ (naštajiru) /naʃ.ta.d͡ʒi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَجَرَ (ištajara)
# نَشْتَجِرَ (naštajira) /naʃ.ta.d͡ʒi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَجَرَ (ištajara)
# نَشْتَجِرْ (naštajir) /naʃ.ta.d͡ʒir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَجَرَ (ištajara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
